text:
Arielle Knox: quick usability snag from user testing: in the vectors preview modal the download action is an icon-only button nested before the kebab. keyboard users tab to Export (which is actually visually in the middle) and it feels awkward. can we align DOM order with visual order?
Diego Morales: that matches a recent change where we injected export early. easy fix: reorder DOM so actions read L->R visually. confirm we don't break any js selectors.
Priya Shah: copy nit: prefer 'Download (CSV)' for visible label and tooltip "Download selected vectors as CSV". avoid using 'Export' inconsistently across UI.
Sam Holt: accessibility: ensure icon buttons have descriptive aria-labels if we keep icon-only. current aria-label is just "export" which is too vague. suggest "Download selected vectors (CSV)".
A11y QA: screen readers follow DOM order. reorder is the least-brittle fix. also add role="toolbar" on actions container and aria-describedby on the modal heading referencing the sample count summary. and provide an aria-live polite region for selection changes: "Showing 8 vectors — 3 selected."
Arielle Knox: interaction detail: when opening preview, focus should land on the modal heading and then the first interactive element (primary CTA) when user presses Tab. currently focus is on close X which is confusing for VoiceOver users.
Diego Morales: implement focus trap + initial focus to heading. dev note: `focusableElements[1]` logic is brittle, will set explicit tabindex=0 on primary action for initial focus.
Priya Shah: microcopy for rerank: keep visible label 'Rerank' but tooltip -> 'Rerank selected vectors — preview changes'. small tweak but helps clarity.
Sam Holt: keyboard shortcut idea: scoped 'D' to download selected rows when table has focus. show hint in toolbar: "Download (D)". ensure we announce "Downloading X selected vectors" via aria-live and avoid double announcements.
A11y QA: test matrix: VoiceOver mac, NVDA, TalkBack, and iOS. also test shorthand keys when modals are open. Debounce aria-live updates for selection by 250-300ms to avoid chatter.
Arielle Knox: CSV header suggestion: include 'original_index' and 'exported_at' fields. filename pattern: "vectors-<space>-selected-<YYYYMMDD>.csv" to clarify scope.
Diego Morales: backend will add original_index and exported_at (ISO8601 UTC). we'll include API flag `include_indices=true`.
DesignBot: Created issue #5389: "Vectors preview: download discoverability, DOM order, aria-live selection, Download (D) shortcut, CSV headers" and assigned to Diego Morales. :white_check_mark:
A11y QA: i'll attach checklist to #5389 and request a quick review after PR. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
